definitions.explanation: The organized, interrelated whole formed by a country's laws — the way its statutes, codes, and regulations fit together as a structured system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{法体系|ほうたいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{法体系|ほうたいけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: Legal systems differ greatly from country to country.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{登場|とうじょう}→登場：13625_toujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{既存|きそん}→既存：27736_kison⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{法体系|ほうたいけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧しきれない⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: With the emergence of new technologies, problems that the existing legal system cannot fully handle are increasing.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (law) + ⟦{体系|たいけい}→体系：04487_taikei⟧ (system, organized structure). Refers to a body of law viewed as a coherent, interconnected whole rather than as individual statutes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {法体系|ほうたいけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to put a legal system in order
- ⟦{既存|きそん}→既存：27736_kison⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{法体系|ほうたいけい}: the existing legal system
- {大陸法|たいりくほう}{系|けい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{法体系|ほうたいけい}: a civil-law-based legal system

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {法制度|ほうせいど}: legal system (as institutions and their workings) — overlaps closely, but emphasizes the institutional side
- ⟦{六法|ろっぽう}→六法：06612_roppou⟧: the Six Codes — the core statutes at the center of Japan's legal system
